title: hearty ethiopian chicken wot with egg
description: a rich, spicy, and comforting ethiopian dish made with char-grilled chicken, flavorful onions, and creamy fromage frais. perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: char-grill the chicken breast over medium-high heat until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side.
let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sauté the sliced onions until they are lightly browned and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the red pepper flakes, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the spices are fragrant.
add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5-7 minutes, until it has thickened slightly.
stir in the crumbled fromage frais and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
add the sliced chicken to the pan and toss it in the sauce until the chicken is coated.
serve the chicken and sauce over injera bread or with steamed vegetables.
garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and a dollop of fromage frais, if desired.
